description: This file defines abstract and concrete classes for writing Spark event logs, including single and rolling log file writers, with configuration options for compression, overwriting, and file rolling based on size. It manages log file creation, renaming, and directory structure specific to Spark's event logging system.

classes.name: EventLogFileWriter
classes.description: Abstract base class for writing Spark event logs, providing common functionality for log file initialization, writing, renaming, and configuration.

classes.name: SingleEventLogFileWriter
classes.description: Concrete class for writing a single event log file per application, handling creation, writing, and renaming of the log file.

classes.name: RollingEventLogFilesWriter
classes.description: Concrete class for writing event logs into multiple files with size-based rolling, managing directory structure, file naming, and log segmentation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initialize the log file or log directory and prepare for writing.

methods.name: writeEvent
methods.description: Write a JSON-formatted event to the log file.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Finalize logging, close files, and perform any necessary renaming or cleanup.

methods.name: logPath
methods.description: Return the path of the log file or directory for testing or reference.
